# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why this change is needed.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior, or the reason tests are unnecessary is explained.
- [ ] Documentation is updated, or this change has no documentation impact.
- [ ] API, OpenAPI, JSON Schema, and cross-repository contract impact is described.
- [ ] Database migration and rollback impact is described.
- [ ] Security, permissions, secrets, and privacy impact is reviewed.
- [ ] Generated files were produced from their source rather than edited by hand.
